reason: Article 13(6) directly mandates that ICT security awareness programmes and digital operational resilience training be compulsory modules in staff training schemes, which aligns with the control objective. The evidence confirms this provision requires training for all employees and senior management, with complexity appropriate to their roles.
evidence_excerpt: 6. Financial entities shall develop ICT security awareness programmes and digital operational resilience training as compulsory modules in their staff training schemes. applicability_note: The mapping is specific to Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, which applies to financial entities as defined in the regulation. The control is directly addressed by Article 13(6) without requiring a minimum number of training hours.
challenge_comment: While other articles (e.g., 5(2)(g), 16(1)(h)) reference training, they do not independently establish the mandatory nature of the training itself. Article 13(6) is the primary and sufficient basis for this control.
